Maya (Support): heads-up — customer Panorama Health reporting large throughput + latency regression on their dedicated pool in eu-west-1. started ~2026-03-18 08:12 UTC. they say requests/sec dropped ~6x and p95 jumped to ~450ms.
Sam (Sales): Oof. Panorama is on a committed contract with renewal in 3 weeks. SLA penalties possible if we don't show remediation plan.
Priya (PM): Can we get a short impact summary and repro? Need to decide whether this becomes a P0 roadmap pull-in or support ticket.
Maya (Support): Repro steps from customer: 1) hitting endpoint `/v1/dedicated/panorama-01/generate` 2) 40 concurrent clients, seq_len ~1024 tokens 3) workload is streaming chat + tool calls. They provided request ids: r: pan-req-2234, pan-req-2235.
Jon (Eng Runtime): Can you paste the tail of the runtime logs and a flame for p50/p95? Also which model variant — quantized int8 or fp16?
Maya (Support): Customer says they're on `redwood-dedicated-v2-13b-quant`. Logs (customer-provided):
```
2026-03-18T08:11:57Z GPU mem usage 93% on worker-2
2026-03-18T08:12:01Z batch latency 310ms -> 1.4s
2026-03-18T08:12:03Z kv-cache miss spike 76%
2026-03-18T08:12:10Z request backlog growing: queued=48
```
Priya (PM): Thanks. Key questions for prioritization: customer impact (revenue/SLAs), reproducibility, short-term mitigation (routing/fallback), and long-term fix. Sam — revenue impact?
Sam (Sales): Panorama is on a $250k/yr committed plan. This account is high-touch. They were clear: if we don't meet p95 SLA this billing period they can request credit. Need resolution or concrete mitigation w/in 72h.
Natalie (Oncall): incidents-bot: detected surge on `panorama-01` pool at 2026-03-18T08:11:45Z. Mean GPU utilization jumped from 65% to 92% in 30s. Link: https://incidents/redwood/1924506789/trace (internal).
Jon (Eng Runtime): Looking at the trace now — queue depth spikes correlated with a small subset of request shapes (long prefix + function outputs). We may be hitting batch packing regressions with streaming enabled. Quick check: can customer try disabling streaming to see if latency drops?
Maya (Support): Asked customer to test non-streaming; they replied: non-streaming p95 ~180ms (improved but still > target 120ms), throughput up ~2x but not full recovery.
Priya (PM): Okay. Short-term mitigation options: 1) Route Panorama to a heavier instance SKU (burst) 2) Temporarily fallback to fp16 model variant 3) Tune batching/windowing to prefer latency SLO for this pool. Rank them by effort and risk please.
Jon (Eng Runtime): Effort/risk quick take: 1) route to burst pool — medium effort (infra + billing gating) but low code risk. 2) fallback to fp16 — low effort if variant already available, risk: quality delta. 3) batching change — high effort and risk for regressions.
Sam (Sales): Customer would accept temporary fallback to fp16 if we commit to evaluating quality impacts and a rollback plan. They want communication today.
Priya (PM): Decision: triage path = immediate fallback to `redwood-dedicated-v2-13b-fp16` + enable burst routing if fallback insufficient. Jon/Natalie, can you implement fallback and monitor for 4 hours? If not doable in 2h, escalate.
Jon (Eng Runtime): I'll push a canary fallback for 10% traffic in 30m and monitor. If stable, expand. Will post logs and metrics.
Natalie (Oncall): Setting alert for p95 > 200ms on panorama pool and paging if > 10min. incidents-bot: create incident ticket #INC-20260318-06.
Maya (Support): Communicated plan to customer: fallback canary + daily updates, flagged for 72h SLA window. Customer responded :eyes: wants ETA for full root cause.
Priya (PM): For the backlog: Create a customer-driven epic: 'panorama throughput regression root cause & batching resilience' — include acceptance criteria: root cause identified, mitigation implemented (auto-fallback or routing), test cover for streaming+batches, postmortem, and customer QA. Prioritize as P1 but escalate to P0 if we see recurrence after mitigation.
Sam (Sales): Please include renewal notes and credits calc if SLA breached. I will hold renewal conversation contingent on our 72h plan.
Jon (Eng Runtime): Posting canary rollout plan here: `cfg.routing.policy=canary(variant=fp16, pct=10)` then monitor `requests/second`, `p95`, `gpu_util`. Will attach graphs.
Priya (PM): Thanks team. I'll create the epic and add tasks for Eng, Oncall, Support, and Sales. Assigning owners: Jon (eng), Natalie (oncall), Maya (support), Sam (sales).
Maya (Support): Will keep customer updated hourly and paste logs here.
incidents-bot: Incident INC-20260318-06 created by Natalie. Status: investigating.
Natalie (Oncall): Initial canary shows p95 at 170ms for canary traffic, queued requests dropping. continuing monitoring.
Priya (PM): Great — keep thread posted. We'll decide backlog priority after 24h of monitoring.
Sam (Sales): I'll schedule a short sync with Panorama for 14:30 UTC to update them.
Jon (Eng Runtime): Attached quick trace snippet (internal link) and will open PR for routing change if canary holds.
Maya (Support): Customer confirms they see improvement on their side for canary traffic. Thanks :thumbsup:.
